step1.title: Marko 6: Fulfilling the Promise of Less JavaScript w/ Dylan Piercey
step1.description: We've seen a lot of technology compete in the low JavaScript space but from what I've seen none do it better than Marko. Because Marko scales with the demand, automatically. Forget Islands, forget `$`, forget your low JS library for your non-JS backend. Dylan Piercey joins us on stream again to talk about the much anticipated Marko 6 Beta.
